# JORU

> JORU is a trading journal for traders who want to understand what drives their results. Record and review trades, track equity and drawdowns, compare trading scenarios, and define strategy rules in one application for Windows and macOS.

JORU is a desktop trading journal for Windows and macOS. Also known as J.L.JÖRMUNGANDR, JLJ.
